title: Uncovering Bias Mechanisms in Observational Studies

split.decision: Four mechanisms; unchanged d=6, 50000 fitting patients and 40000 evaluation candidates per cohort, first 2000 eligible OS rows per statistic. Public validation is the complete seed-99 stream, 200 replications per mechanism. Hidden materialization uses independent secret streams; precision and replication decisions are documented in operator NOTES. Inputs contain only measured features and factual selected outcomes; IDs/order are opaque. No cross-instance training.
